51:t_1:175.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah, that's right. These are my friends from $c.」

51:t_1:177.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Nice. All the girls here look so healthy.」

51:t_1:178.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Let's have some fun getting to know another culture.」

51:t_1:179.en:
$$メルティ$$
「Hot guys! And so many super-hot ones!」

51:t_1:181.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「Sorry. $$メルティ$$'s excited because her wish came true.」

51:t_1:182.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm not sure I follow, but good for her...」

51:t_1:183.en:
$$メルティ$$
「You're staying here for a while, right? Then I'll show you around the fleet instead of $$ガロード$$.」

51:t_1:184.en:
$$ティファ$$
「$$メルティ$$... What about your work as a 《$$メッセンジャー$$》?」

51:t_1:185.en:
$$メルティ$$
「I finished that ages ago.」

51:t_1:186.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Huh... Speaking of which, where's $$エイミー$$?」

51:t_1:187.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「$$エイミー$$ went to look at the treasure $$ベローズ$$ hauled up.」

51:t_1:189.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's clearly a weapon. And it's still operational.」

51:t_1:190.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then wouldn't it have been better for $c to investigate it?」

51:t_1:191.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's what I said. So did $$ルカ$$, $$サックス$$ and $$鉄っつぁん$$...」

51:t_1:192.en:
$$クルツ$$
「We can't help it. That $$ピニオン$$ guy won't let us lay a finger on it.」

51:t_1:193.en:
$$マオ$$
「He'll give up sooner or later. Then it'll be our turn.」

51:t_1:194.en:
$$パーラ$$
「It's been pretty noisy for a while, though.」

51:t_1:195.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Don't tell me... Have pirates or $$サイデリアル$$ shown up?」

51:t_1:196.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah, this is $$ガロード$$.」

51:t_1:197.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「$$ガロード$$! We've got trouble!」

51:t_1:198.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Someone was inside that treasure! They grabbed $$エイミー$$, who'd come to take a look, as a hostage and ran off!」

51:t_1:200.en:
$$ティファ$$
「$$ガロード$$! Look at that!」

51:t_1:201.en:
$$レド$$
[How is this block even laid out...?!]

51:t_1:202.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You...! You! Let me go!」

51:t_1:203.en:
$$レド$$
[Damn it...! How did it come to this...?!]

51:t_1:204.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[I cannot identify any logic in your actions.]

51:t_1:205.en:
$$レド$$
[It was my mistake to be seen leaving the unit. With a hostage, these people won't attack us, at least...!]

51:t_1:206.en:
$$レド$$
[But this hostage... is awfully loud. And I can barely understand the language.]

51:t_1:207.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[The preceding remarks referred to reproduction with a mother and sacred excrement.]

51:t_1:208.en:
$$レド$$
[They're not sane after all! This is why drifter tribes...!]

51:t_1:209.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[I propose doubt. We cannot conclude that this group is a tribe of drifters.]

51:t_1:211.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[None of the footage gathered so far shows any equipment or precautions for changes in gravity, radiation or airtightness.]

51:t_1:212.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[I infer that this facility was designed for an environment entirely free of vacuum or zero gravity.]

51:t_1:214.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Agreed. However, the records contain one possible exception...]

51:t_1:216.en:
$n
「Drop your weapon and release the hostage!」

51:t_1:219.en:
$$かなめ$$
「What do you mean, 'good', $n?! You let him get away so easily!」

51:t_1:221.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Huh... But... We've already lost sight of him...」

51:t_1:222.en:
$$宗介$$
「On $n and $$ガロード$$'s orders, we have already positioned people along the intruder's route.」

51:t_1:223.en:
$n
「He shows no intention of attacking. By using his tendency to flee from us, we can control his escape route.」

51:t_1:224.en:
$$宗介$$
「Now he's a rat in a trap. The rest...」

51:t_1:225.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「You can leave to us...」

51:t_1:232.en:
$$レド$$
[What is this...? Where on earth am I...?]

51:t_1:237.en:
$$レド$$
[I've been shot...! And the hostage got away too!]

51:t_1:238.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Ensign $$レド$$'s vital signs indicate a minor wound. Please consider your next action.]

51:t_1:241.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「That last shot only grazed you. Make a wrong move, and I'll take you out of action.」

51:t_1:245.en:
$$レド$$
[If I could tell them what we want, I could show them we mean no harm, but...]

51:t_1:246.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[The basic language structure matches that of our newly allied forces. Unimpeded communication will soon be possible.]

51:t_1:247.en:
$$レド$$
[First, assess the situation. What is this place?]

51:t_1:248.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[I infer that you and this unit are on the surface of a planet with a breathable atmosphere.]

51:t_1:250.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Comparing observable celestial bodies with recorded data...]

51:t_1:251.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Confirmed. Only one matching entry.]

51:t_1:252.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[The third planet of the Solar System: Earth.]

51:t_1:254.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[The birthplace of humanity, whose existence has until now been suggested only by records.]

51:t_1:256.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Warning. Multiple units are approaching from the surrounding area.]

51:t_1:257.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Identification signals indicate $$サイデリアル$$.]

51:t_1:225-226: Preserved row split; proposed Sniper Casanovas as localization of the sniper/pickup-artist pun.
